user.title: Zonentra building
user.description: One Home Assistant, one Zonentra, one building. Demand and outdoor unit proposals are simulations only; existing controllers remain independent.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Zonentra building is allowed per Home Assistant installation.

init.title: Building topology
init.description: Edits remain provisional until Save. Closing the dialog discards them.

menu_options.group: Add or edit an outdoor unit group

zone_details.title: Zone
zone_details.description: Zones use the central configuration by default. Disable a building choice and press Next to enter local values. Existing local values remain available when switching back. Zonentra does not control equipment.

data.name: Name
data.sensor_validation: Sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

group_details.title: Outdoor unit group
group_details.description: The feedback source must report heat, cool or off. Use reliable feedback, not a requested mode. Without feedback the actual mode stays unknown. Every proposal is read-only.

equipment_details.title: Equipment
equipment_details.description: Optional links can be cleared. No equipment is controlled.

building.title: Central configuration
building.description: These analysis limits and parameters apply to zones that select building settings. Outdoor temperature always belongs to the whole building. Older outdoor sources still awaiting a choice: {outdoor_candidates}. No equipment is controlled.

data.sensor_validation: Central sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Central maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

error.invalid_id: Use lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (1–64 characters).
error.invalid_entity: Choose an entity with the correct domain, outside Zonentra.
error.invalid_reference: A zone or group is missing or is still referenced. Remove equipment links first.
error.invalid_group: Only HVAC equipment can belong to an outdoor unit group.
error.duplicate_equipment_entity: This physical entity is already registered as equipment.
error.entity_not_found: The new entity link must exist in Home Assistant.
error.add_zone_first: Add a zone before registering equipment. Close this dialog and reopen Options.
error.invalid_parameters: Invalid parameters: use finite values within the indicated ranges. update_based requires a maximum update age above 0.
error.invalid_limits: Configure both limits. Heating limit plus twice the hysteresis must be lower than the cooling limit.
error.conflicting_group: The equipment group differs from its zone group.
